name: Sikalastic-488 (au)
paste:
SIKALASTIC®-488 (AU): SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sikalastic®-488 (au), April 2023, Version 01.07 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/9/sikalastic-488-au.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sikalastic®-488 (au) where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.07).
1.2 Product description.
    - Sikalastic®-488 is a high performance, hand-applied, low VOC, moisture-curing single-pack elastomeric polyurethane waterproofing membrane. Sikalastic®- 488 is directly foot-trafficable.
    - Sikalastic®-488 is the base coat membrane used within the SikaRoof® MTC-UV systems.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. It is designed for diverse waterproofing including:
    - Balconies
    - Terraces
    - Podium decks
    - Plant room floors
    - Inverted roofs
    - Under tile beds
    - Under paver-pad systems
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.8.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sikalastic®-488 (au)
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Moisture-curing single-pack elastomeric polyurethane waterproofing membrane
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates. AS / NZS 4654.1:2012 Waterproofing membranes for external above-ground (CSIRO approved)
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - AS / NZS 4654.1:2012: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Seamless membrane
    - High resistance to puncture and standing water
    - Quick tack-free surface
    - Low VOC
    - High elongation
    - Class III membrane
    - Crack bridging capability, no reinforcement needed
    - Elastomeric behaviour
    - Single pack, ready to use
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Single-Pack moisture curing Polyurethane
    - Colour: Light Grey
    - Density: 1.30-1.35 (g/cm3)
    - Viscosity: 10,000-18000cP @30 RPM
    - Volatile organic compound (VOC) content: 250g/L
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Shore A hardness: 70 Shore A
    - Tensile strength: 6 MPa
    - Tensile strain at break: 300%
    - Tear strength: 20 kg/cm
    - Service temperature: -20 to +80 oC
2.7 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 15 Litres
    - Shelf life: 9 months
    - Storage conditions: From date of production if stored properly in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5°C and +30°C.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.07) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate preparation. Surface must be clean, sound, smooth and dust-free as well as oil-free. Please refer to the 'SikaRoof® MTC-UV systems' method statement for further information.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.07) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Consumption: SikaRoof® MTC-12 UV; 1.2mm DFT system- 10m2 per 15L pail; SikaRoof® MTC-14 UV; 1.4mm DFT system- 8.6m2 per 15L pail; SikaRoof® MTC-20 UV; 2.0mm DFT system- 6m2 per 15L pail
4.3 Dry film thickness. SikaRoof® MTC-12 UV; 1.2mm DFT system- 2x coats of 750 micron wet film thickness required SikaRoof® MTC-14 UV; 1.4mm DFT system- 2x coats of 870 micron wet film thickness required SikaRoof® MTC-20 UV; 2.0mm DFT system- 3x coats of 830 micron wet film thickness required
4.4 Waiting time to overcoating. In normal conditions, Sikalastic®-488 can be recoated with another layer of Sikalastic®-488 after one night and within 2 days. In case of rain or if the recoating interval was exceeded, light abrasion and reactivate this with Sika Thinner C, come back to the substrate by grinding.
4.5 Mixing. Ready-to-use pails. Mix until homogenous.
4.6 Application.
    - Sikalastic®-488 can be applied with a brush or a roller to the desired thickness.
    - Apply Sikalastic®-488 (au) at the recommended coverage rates for the specific SikaRoof® MTC-UV system that is being installed. The dry film thickness for each coat is mentioned on this PDS.
    - Allow Sikalastic®-488 (au) to cure for a minimum 16 hours or until tack free before applying the following layer.
    - Do not allow more than 48 hours between coats of Sikalastic®-488 (au) otherwise abrasion and reactivation will be required before proceeding.
    - Sikalastic®-488 can be subject to foot traffic after 24 hours.
4.7 Cleaning of equipment. Reusable tools should be cleaned carefully with Sika Thinner C before curing.
4.8 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Do not install Sikalastic®-488 (au) without the use of a primer.
    - Do not apply Sikalastic®-488 (au) when rain is imminent within 8-12 hour period of application.
    - Always check dew point before application of Sikalastic®-488 (au).
    - Do not dilute/thin Sikalastic®-488 (au) with solvents.
    - To avoid outgassing and pinholing, apply Sikalastic®- 488 (au) on a declining temperature or out of direct sunlight where possible. Adhere to the substrate temperatures on the PDS.
    - If surface is porous, double priming may be required to effectively seal the substrate before application of Sikalastic®-488 (au).
    - Do not under apply Sikalastic®-488 (au) as this will impact product performance and may cause premature degradation. Please refer to the SikaRoof® MTC-UV system data sheets for the build-up of each individual system.
    - Vehicle traffic is not permitted on Sikalastic®-488.
    - Sikalastic®-488 can be directly foot- trafficable due to its high resistance to puncture and hardness.
    - Sikalastic®-488 (au) when exposed to UV light will discolour and chalking of the surface may occur which could effect the products performance long term. It is highly recommended that a top coat be applied. Please refer to the SikaRoof® MTC-UV system data sheets.
4.9 Further information.
    - Sika Method Statement: SikaRoof® MTC-UV systems
    - System Data Sheets: SikaRoof® MTC-12 UV, SikaRoof® MTC-14 UV, SikaRoof® MTC-20 UV

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Relative air humidity. Between 20 and 90%
5.3 Substrate temperature. +5 to +35 oC
5.4 Substrate moisture content. Up to 5%
5.5 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.8):
    - Do not apply Sikalastic®-488 (au) when rain is imminent within 8-12 hour period of application.
    - Always check dew point before application of Sikalastic®-488 (au).
    - To avoid outgassing and pinholing, apply Sikalastic®- 488 (au) on a declining temperature or out of direct sunlight where possible. Adhere to the substrate temperatures on the PDS.
5.6 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.7 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sikalastic®-488 (au), April 2023, Version 01.07, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/9/sikalastic-488-au.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sikalastic®-488 (au), version 18/06/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/y/sds-sikalastic-488au.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
